```{r}
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# LEGEND NUMBERS — helper
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
LEGEND_FILE <- "SuppFigure1_legend_numbers.txt"
cat("Supplementary Figure 1 - legend numbers\nGenerated: ", format(Sys.time()), "\n",
    file = LEGEND_FILE, sep = "")
legend_out <- function(title, x = NULL) {
  body <- if (is.null(x)) character(0) else if (is.character(x)) x
          else utils::capture.output(print(as.data.frame(x), row.names = FALSE))
  txt <- c("", paste0("=== ", title, " ==="), body)
  cat(txt, sep = "\n"); cat(txt, sep = "\n", file = LEGEND_FILE, append = TRUE)
  invisible(NULL)
}
n_si <- function(df, ..., id = "MM_ID") {
  df %>% dplyr::group_by(...) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(n_samples = dplyr::n(),
                     n_infants = dplyr::n_distinct(.data[[id]]), .groups = "drop")
}

# Likelihood-ratio test of one term in a mixed model, adjusted for the
# technical covariates and postnatal age, with a random intercept per infant.
# Used for every "overall" statement in the legend.
lmm_term <- function(data, outcome, term, covs = c("Postnatal_Age", "Clean_reads_P1", "DNA_conc")) {
  d <- data[stats::complete.cases(data[, c(outcome, term, covs, "MM_ID")]), , drop = FALSE]
  for (v in covs) d[[paste0(v, "_z")]] <- as.numeric(scale(as.numeric(d[[v]])))
  rhs0 <- paste(paste0(covs, "_z"), collapse = " + ")
  m0 <- lmer(stats::as.formula(paste(outcome, "~", rhs0, "+ (1|MM_ID)")),
             data = d, REML = FALSE)
  m1 <- lmer(stats::as.formula(paste(outcome, "~", rhs0, "+", term, "+ (1|MM_ID)")),
             data = d, REML = FALSE)
  cf <- summary(m1)$coefficients
  r  <- grep(paste0("^", term), rownames(cf))[1]
  sprintf("n = %d samples / %d infants | effect = %.3f (SE %.3f) | LRT p = %.3g",
          nrow(d), dplyr::n_distinct(d$MM_ID), cf[r, 1], cf[r, 2],
          stats::anova(m1, m0)[["Pr(>Chisq)"]][2])
}
```

```{r}
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# DATA — same preparation as Figure 1
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# The probiotic species are retained here: this figure describes the overall
# diversity and composition of the cohort.
metadata     <- read.delim("metadata_cleaned_april.txt")
taxa_cleaned <- read.delim("taxa_cleaned_jan.txt")
row.names(taxa_cleaned) <- taxa_cleaned$ID; taxa_cleaned$ID <- NULL
row.names(metadata) <- metadata$ID

metadata_infant <- metadata[grep("^B", rownames(metadata)), ]
taxa_infant     <- taxa_cleaned[grep("^B", rownames(taxa_cleaned)), ]

factor_vars <- c("prolonged_rupt", "surgery", "ab48", "multiple", "delivery_md",
                 "maternal_atb", "mother_st_com", "placenta_ab", "pe_hellp",
                 "maternal_infect", "mother_b_hem", "nec",
                 "sex", "sip", "sepsis_culture", "pda_sign", "mortality",
                 "pda", "probiotics", "SGA", "LGA", "FGR", "ivh", "abtx")
numeric_vars <- c("mmpercentage", "probiotic_sample", "apgar_1", "apgar_5",
                  "antibiotic_sample", "ga_exact", "bw", "admissiontime", "tpn_days",
                  "TFEF_B", "TFEF", "DNA_conc", "Clean_reads_P1", "week",
                  "Postnatal_Age", "MM_ID")
metadata_infant[factor_vars]  <- lapply(metadata_infant[factor_vars], as.factor)
metadata_infant[numeric_vars] <- lapply(metadata_infant[numeric_vars], as.numeric)

taxa <- taxa_infant[row.names(taxa_infant) %in% rownames(metadata_infant), ]

taxa_sp <- taxa[, grep("s__", colnames(taxa))]
taxa_sp <- taxa_sp[, -grep("t__", colnames(taxa_sp))]
colnames(taxa_sp) <- gsub(".*s__", "", colnames(taxa_sp))
taxa_sp <- taxa_sp %>% mutate(across(everything(), ~ as.numeric(.)))

richness <- plyr::ddply(taxa_sp, ~ rownames(taxa_sp),
                        function(x) data.frame(RICHNESS = sum(x[-1] > 0, na.rm = TRUE)))
row.names(richness) <- richness$`rownames(taxa_sp)`; richness$`rownames(taxa_sp)` <- NULL
my_alpha_diversity <- data.frame(Shannon = diversity(taxa_sp, index = "shannon"),
                                 Simpson = diversity(taxa_sp, index = "simpson"))
my_alpha_diversity <- merge(my_alpha_diversity, richness, by = "row.names")
row.names(my_alpha_diversity) <- my_alpha_diversity$Row.names
my_alpha_diversity$Row.names <- NULL

phenos_imputed_div <- merge(my_alpha_diversity, metadata_infant, by = "row.names")
row.names(phenos_imputed_div) <- phenos_imputed_div$Row.names
phenos_imputed_div$Row.names <- NULL

# Prevalence filter: a species is kept if present above 0.05% in >= 1 infant
taxa_sp$ID <- row.names(taxa_sp)
taxa_sp$personal_ID <- sub("_.*", "", taxa_sp$ID)
unique_counts <- sapply(taxa_sp, function(x)
  length(unique(taxa_sp$personal_ID[x > 0.05])))
taxa_sp_filt <- taxa_sp[, unique_counts >= 1]
taxa_sp_filt$personal_ID <- NULL; taxa_sp_filt$ID <- NULL
taxa_sp$personal_ID <- NULL; taxa_sp$ID <- NULL

my_pseudocount_normal <- min(taxa_sp_filt[taxa_sp_filt != 0]) / 2

# Align the taxa table to the phenotype table by row name.
stopifnot(setequal(row.names(taxa_sp_filt), row.names(phenos_imputed_div)))
taxa_sp_filt <- taxa_sp_filt[row.names(phenos_imputed_div), , drop = FALSE]

my_distance_CLR  <- vegdist(taxa_sp_filt, method = "aitchison",
                            pseudocount = my_pseudocount_normal)
taxa_sp_filt_CLR <- decostand(taxa_sp_filt, "clr", pseudocount = my_pseudocount_normal)

mypcoa_CLR <- cmdscale(my_distance_CLR, k = 20, eig = TRUE)
my_var_CLR <- round(mypcoa_CLR$eig * 100 / sum(mypcoa_CLR$eig), 2)[1:20]
mypcoa_df_CLR <- as.data.frame(mypcoa_CLR$points)
names(mypcoa_df_CLR) <- paste0("PC", 1:20)

phenos_imputed_div_pc_CLR <- merge(mypcoa_df_CLR, phenos_imputed_div, by = "row.names")
row.names(phenos_imputed_div_pc_CLR) <- phenos_imputed_div_pc_CLR$Row.names

# Shared factors
mk_week <- function(x) factor(as.character(x), levels = as.character(1:8),
                              labels = paste0("W", 1:8))
phenos_imputed_div$week        <- mk_week(phenos_imputed_div$week)
phenos_imputed_div_pc_CLR$week <- mk_week(phenos_imputed_div_pc_CLR$week)

legend_out("Supp 1 — analysed infant samples", phenos_imputed_div %>% n_si())
legend_out("Supp 1 — samples / infants per postnatal week",
           phenos_imputed_div %>% n_si(week))
legend_out("Supp 1 — species in the distance / CLR table",
           sprintf("%d species (probiotic species retained); pseudocount %.3g | PCo1 %.2f%%, PCo2 %.2f%%",
                   ncol(taxa_sp_filt), my_pseudocount_normal, my_var_CLR[1], my_var_CLR[2]))
```

```{r}
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# a — PCoA of Aitchison distances coloured by postnatal week
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
all_infants   <- phenos_imputed_div_pc_CLR
infant_colors <- viridis(8, option = "D")

centroids <- do.call(rbind, lapply(levels(all_infants$week), function(w) {
  s <- all_infants[all_infants$week == w, ]
  data.frame(week = w, PC1 = mean(s$PC1), PC2 = mean(s$PC2))
}))
centroids$week <- factor(centroids$week, levels = levels(all_infants$week))

# type = "t": the legend states a multivariate t-distribution. The earlier
# version used type = "norm", which is the normal-theory ellipse.
p_a <- ggplot(all_infants, aes(PC1, PC2, color = week, fill = week)) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  stat_ellipse(aes(group = week), type = "t", linetype = 2, geom = "path",
               show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_point(data = centroids, aes(PC1, PC2, fill = week), shape = 23,
             size = 4, color = "black") +
  xlab(paste0("PCo1 = ", my_var_CLR[1], "%")) +
  ylab(paste0("PCo2 = ", my_var_CLR[2], "%")) +
  scale_color_manual(name = NULL, values = infant_colors) +
  scale_fill_manual(name = NULL, values = infant_colors) +
  theme(axis.line.x = element_line(), axis.line.y = element_line(),
        legend.position = "bottom", legend.key = element_blank(),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 14), axis.title = element_text(size = 14),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 12),
        panel.grid.major = element_blank(), panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        panel.background = element_rect(fill = NA))

p_a <- ggExtra::ggMarginal(p_a, type = "boxplot", groupColour = TRUE,
                           fill = infant_colors)
print(p_a)
ggsave("S1a_PCoA_week.pdf", p_a, width = 6, height = 5, dpi = 300)

d_a <- all_infants %>% filter(!is.na(week), !is.na(Clean_reads_P1), !is.na(DNA_conc))
set.seed(42)
ad_a <- adonis2(as.dist(as.matrix(my_distance_CLR)[rownames(d_a), rownames(d_a)]) ~
                  Clean_reads_P1 + DNA_conc + week,
                data = d_a, permutations = 10000, by = "margin")
legend_out("Supp 1a — PERMANOVA, postnatal week (marginal SS, + reads + DNA conc, 10,000 permutations)",
           sprintf("n = %d samples / %d infants | Df = %d | R2 = %.4f | F = %.2f | p = %.3g",
                   nrow(d_a), dplyr::n_distinct(d_a$MM_ID), ad_a["week", "Df"],
                   ad_a["week", "R2"], ad_a["week", "F"], ad_a["week", "Pr(>F)"]))
legend_out("Supp 1a — samples per week (points in the plot)", all_infants %>% n_si(week))
```

```{r}
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# b — Shannon diversity by postnatal week, stratified by gestational age
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
phenos_imputed_div$gestation <- factor(
  ifelse(phenos_imputed_div$ga_exact < 28, 0, 1),
  levels = c(0, 1), labels = c("<28 weeks", "≥28 weeks"))

# Per-week Wilcoxon, BH across the weeks that could be tested.
week_tests <- function(data, group_var, min_n = 3) {
  res <- purrr::map_dfr(levels(data$week), function(w) {
    d <- data[data$week == w & !is.na(data[[group_var]]) & !is.na(data$Shannon), ]
    g <- droplevels(factor(d[[group_var]]))
    n <- table(g)
    if (nlevels(g) < 2 || any(n < min_n))
      return(tibble(week = w, n1 = unname(n[1]), n2 = if (length(n) > 1) unname(n[2]) else NA,
                    p_value = NA_real_))
    tibble(week = w, n1 = unname(n[1]), n2 = unname(n[2]),
           p_value = suppressWarnings(
             stats::wilcox.test(d$Shannon ~ g, exact = FALSE)$p.value))
  })
  res$p_adj <- NA_real_
  ok <- !is.na(res$p_value)
  res$p_adj[ok] <- stats::p.adjust(res$p_value[ok], method = "BH")
  res$significance <- cut(res$p_adj, c(-Inf, .001, .01, .05, Inf),
                          labels = c("***", "**", "*", ""), right = FALSE)
  res$significance[is.na(res$p_adj)] <- NA
  res
}

stats_b <- week_tests(phenos_imputed_div, "gestation")
max_y <- phenos_imputed_div %>% group_by(week) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(label_y = max(Shannon, na.rm = TRUE) + 0.2, .groups = "drop")
stats_b <- left_join(stats_b, max_y, by = "week")

plot_b <- phenos_imputed_div %>% filter(!is.na(gestation), !is.na(Shannon), !is.na(week))
p_b <- ggplot(plot_b, aes(week, Shannon, fill = gestation, color = gestation)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.4, outlier.colour = NA, position = position_dodge(width = 0.8)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6, position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.3,
                                                          jitter.height = 0,
                                                          dodge.width = 0.8)) +
  geom_text(data = subset(stats_b, !is.na(significance) & significance != ""),
            aes(x = week, y = label_y, label = significance),
            inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 5) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#fa2b13", "#54b7a6")) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("#fa2b13", "#54b7a6")) +
  labs(x = "Postnatal week", y = "Shannon diversity index",
       fill = "Gestational age", color = "Gestational age") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.title = element_text(color = "black", size = 16),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12, angle = 60, hjust = 1),
        legend.position = "bottom")
print(p_b)
ggsave("S1b_shannon_gestational_age.pdf", p_b, width = 6, height = 5, dpi = 300)

legend_out("Supp 1b — samples / infants per week and gestational age group",
           plot_b %>% n_si(week, gestation))
legend_out("Supp 1b — per-week Wilcoxon (two-sided), BH across weeks tested",
           stats_b %>% transmute(week, n_lt28 = n1, n_ge28 = n2,
                                 p_value = signif(p_value, 3), p_adj = signif(p_adj, 3)))
legend_out("Supp 1b — overall LMM: Shannon ~ gestational age group + age + reads + DNA conc + (1|infant)",
           lmm_term(plot_b, "Shannon", "gestation"))
legend_out("Supp 1b — overall LMM with gestational age as a continuous variable",
           lmm_term(phenos_imputed_div, "Shannon", "ga_exact"))
```

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# c — Shannon diversity against days of antibiotic exposure (continuous)
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
plot_c <- phenos_imputed_div %>% filter(!is.na(antibiotic_sample), !is.na(Shannon))

p_c <- ggplot(plot_c, aes(antibiotic_sample, Shannon)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = week), alpha = 0.7, size = 2) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "black", fill = "grey70",
              linewidth = 0.6, alpha = 0.25) +
  scale_color_viridis_d(name = "Week", option = "D") +
  labs(x = "Days of antibiotic exposure", y = "Shannon diversity index") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.title = element_text(color = "black", size = 16),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 12),
        panel.grid.major = element_blank(), panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "bottom")
print(p_c)
ggsave("S1c_shannon_antibiotic_continuous.pdf", p_c, width = 6, height = 5, dpi = 300)

# The smoother is a straight line (lm), matching the model reported below.
legend_out("Supp 1c — LMM: Shannon ~ days of antibiotics + age + reads + DNA conc + (1|infant)",
           lmm_term(plot_c, "Shannon", "antibiotic_sample"))
legend_out("Supp 1c — days of antibiotics",
           sprintf("n = %d samples / %d infants | median %g, range %g-%g days",
                   nrow(plot_c), dplyr::n_distinct(plot_c$MM_ID),
                   median(plot_c$antibiotic_sample), min(plot_c$antibiotic_sample),
                   max(plot_c$antibiotic_sample)))
